summary: Initializes the instance by creating a dictionary mapping normalized SKUs to the provided Product objects from the input iterable.
inputs: products (Iterable[Product]): Iterable of Product objects to populate the instance mapping.
outputs: self.products (Dict[str, Product]): Instance dictionary mapping normalized SKU strings to Product objects, populated from the input.
main_effect: Iterate over products; for each product, compute key = <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.catalog.normalize_sku</SPL>(product.sku) and assign self.products[key] = product
side_effects: self.products (Dict[str, Product]): Instance dictionary mapping normalized SKU strings to Product objects, populated from the input.
errors: An element in products lacks a sku attribute
AttributeError: Encountered a product without a sku attribute.
TypeError: The provided products argument is not iterable.
TypeError: Unhashable key cannot be used in dict assignment.
products is not iterable when the for-loop begins

loops.code:
for product in products:
            self.products[normalize_sku(product.sku)] = product
